chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'ir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

A Bedouin from the Banu Tamim came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'Advise me.' Among what he advised him with was that he said, 'O so-and-so! Do not be stingy regarding the act of kindness with its deserving ones.'

key_terms.أَهْلِهِ: Its deserving ones / those entitled to it
key_terms.الْمَعْرُوف: Acts of kindness / goodness / customary benevolence

ai.seo_question: What was the specific advice the Prophet gave to the Bedouin of Banu Tamim regarding kindness?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s practical guidance to a Bedouin from Banu Tamim, urging him not to withhold 'al-ma'ruf' (goodness/kindness) from its rightful recipients. This instruction underscores the Shia emphasis on social reciprocity and the obligation to maintain familial and communal bonds through consistent generosity, reflecting the broader ethical framework of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A Bedouin from the Clan of Tameem came over to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, so he said, ‘Advise me’. So, among what he<sup>saww</sup> advised him with was that he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O so and so! Do not abstain regarding the act of kindness with its deserving ones’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from Hisham ibn Salim from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,

‘Once an Arab man from the tribe of banu al-Tamim came to see the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and said, ‘Please grant me good advice.’ The good advice the Holy Prophet provided was this, ‘O so and so, do not withhold Benevolent Assistance from deserving recipients.’”
